hypothesis: The frozen fixture contains a load-only deadline effect in FIXED_REPLAY and a separate cue-content-by-response effect in the transient-cue regime; stable and no-information controls have zero interactions. This is a test of factorial identification and audit mechanics, not a GUI effect estimate.

design.order: Eight cyclic rotations of the canonical 8-cell order are shuffled with random.Random(base_seed + regime_index); seed position selects one row. This balances every cell at every position within each regime.

simulator.reset: Each regime/seed/cell begins from the same immutable reset identity; all 8 cells in a seed block share exogenous state.
simulator.single_event_loop: Observation blocks the event loop for queue_delay_s + observation_cost_s. Cue delivery completes at that time; content level cannot change its schedule or byte length.
simulator.cue_payload: Canonical ASCII JSON {"cue":<code>}; all three codes have equal byte length. INFORMATIVE returns the regime cue_state; SHAM always returns MASKED and conveys no task state.
simulator.reactive_rule: URGENT evidence triggers exactly one confirmation observation only if its completion plus release and persistence delays fit before both task deadline and cue validity; otherwise YIELD. NEUTRL or MASKED uses the already-authorized nominal submission schedule. The rule reads only delivered cue codes.
simulator.effect_oracle: SUBMIT produces the synthetic persisted target effect only when its confirmation/release trace is complete; task_success additionally requires persisted_effect_at <= task_deadline. No effect follows a YIELD or an action that missed admission before deadline.

estimands.load_only: In load_only_tight_deadline, mean task_success(LOADED - MINIMAL), pooled over cue_content and response_rule.
estimands.content_response: In transient_urgent_cue, [INFORMATIVE - SHAM under OBSERVATION_REACTIVE] - [INFORMATIVE - SHAM under FIXED_REPLAY], pooled equally over load levels.
estimands.controls: The same content_response contrast in stable_urgent_cue and no_decision_information must be within 0.10 of zero.
estimands.classification: load-dominant if |load_only| >= 0.50 and |content_response| < 0.25; content-response-dominant if |content_response| >= 0.25 and |load_only| < 0.50; mixed if both thresholds are met; no-replication otherwise. Report the exact finite fixture contrasts and never infer a live effect.

gates.method_pass: All 256 attempts reconstruct independently; all 8 cells and balanced order positions are present per seed block; truthful/sham payload size and delivery slot match within each load; decisions follow the declared evidence; releases/effects/deadlines reconcile; all five mutations are rejected.
gates.first_outcome: Retain PASS_METHOD_SCOPED or the first HOLD/STOP/FAIL unchanged. No candidate rerun after an outcome; audit-only repair must use a new version and the original raw bytes.

scope.runtime: Python standard library on the local host; CPU-only deterministic enumeration.
limitations: Synthetic deterministic timing and cue logic only.
The designed signature is not a causal estimate or evidence that real GUI observation load changes task outcomes.
No claim about OS scheduling, screenshot/accessibility APIs, controller quality, safety, user tempo, or product behavior.
